# Math (KaTeX)

Inline math renders within a sentence: the mass–energy relation $E = mc^2$ and a fraction $\tfrac{1}{2}$ sit on the text baseline.

Block math is centered on its own line:

$$
\int_{0}^{\infty} e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
$$

A second block with a sum, to verify wide-content horizontal scroll behavior:

$$
\sum_{i=1}^{n} i = \frac{n(n+1)}{2}
$$
